title: OpenAI reports performance gains from Forward Deployed Engineering deployments
excerpt: OpenAI detailed how its engineering teams use custom implementations to scale AI solutions for enterprise customers.
bodyHtml:
OpenAI announced on October 22, 2026, that its Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team has implemented AI-native workflows for various enterprise partners. Colin Jarvis, Head of Forward Deployed Engineering, stated that the team focuses on closing the deployment gap between model capabilities and practical, real-world use cases.

In a mid-2025 engagement with a semiconductor customer, the team achieved a 48% time saving through AI-based directed test generation and a 22% median performance improvement through kernel optimization. The team also reported that weeks of debugging were compressed into hours.

A pilot program for Tax AI with Thrive Holdings processed 7,000 tax returns, resulting in a 50% increase in throughput. Additionally, a voice-based customer service platform for a telecommunications partner improved from 60% to over 90% on key production evals over a six-month period.

The team also noted that for one project, an initial deployment took two months, while extending the solution to a second team in August 2026 took one day.
